2580→
  • WASM plugins.
  • Compat L2 and 70%+ popular plugin matrix.
  • Multi-window polish, a11y certification efforts.
  • Enterprise: policy, private registry, airgap.
  • Local model runtime first-class.
  • Collaborative editing research (CRDT) — only if product demands.

    • Years 4–10

    • Protocol major v2 if needed; dual-stack.
      • 2590→
    • UI toolkit evolution without core rewrite.
    • Potential buffer CRDT for collab.
    • Continuous security/supply-chain hardening.
    • Language/runtime updates; never depend on abandoned nightlies.

    Cross-Cutting Roadmap Risks
